subject.title: feat(eval): add auditable native matrix runner

question: Should ShellBench support this AWS/Crabbox native matrix runner as an official evaluation route whose outputs may be calibrated for leaderboard use alongside Harbor?
rationale: The patch is an implementation of a new operational and ranking-integrity contract, not a pre-existing narrowly defined behavior; maintainers must choose the supported execution and calibration boundary before code review alone can settle acceptance.

options.title: Stage it behind an experimental workflow
options.body: Approve a bounded native-run experiment with documented non-ranking defaults until an end-to-end parity package demonstrates eligibility.

options.title: Adopt it as a supported route
options.body: Accept the operational ownership of worker provisioning, credentials, retention, and Harbor-calibration requirements before merge.

options.title: Keep native execution external
options.body: Retain Harbor as the repository-owned runner and move this fleet workflow to a separately operated evaluation environment.

recommendation.title: Stage it behind an experimental workflow
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded native-run experiment with documented non-ranking defaults until an end-to-end parity package demonstrates eligibility.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the canonical proposal and the full native-runner implementation, making them the best available technical context holder for a maintainer sponsorship decision.
